ueberMich.metaDescription: Get to know Janine, a copywriter with a passion for clear, effective language.
paragraphs: I'm Janine, and I don't just love to travel, I love writing about it too. I'm an absolute action fan and always up for the next adventure.

When I'm not out catching the next wave, I live in Düsseldorf on the beautiful Rhine. Even here, away from work, I'm looking for action: whether it's inline skating along the Rhine, a horseback ride through the forest, or kickboxing. I'm always on the lookout for new challenges.

Travel, sport and adventure shape my everyday life and my stories. Whether far away or right on my doorstep, I love seizing every opportunity to experience something new and gather authentic travel experiences.

Since tourism excites me professionally as much as my private travels do, after training as a certified travel and leisure specialist I went on to complete a state-certified business economics qualification specialising in tourism. Even during that time, I was already writing copy for the website and social media at my training company.

After a brief stint at a media agency, my path led me to the tour operator alltours. In sales marketing, I was able to deepen my writing skills further, producing numerous newsletters and magazines, from booking guides for travellers to magazines that kept travel agencies informed of the latest news. Always with the goal of presenting trips and destinations in an appealing way.
I've also worked for Freizeitpark Wisseler See GmbH, helping shape the imagery and copy for their new website.
I live out my passion for travel, outdoor adventure and storytelling every day.

datenschutz.metaDescription: Privacy policy for Janine: information on the processing of personal data under the GDPR.
datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: Protecting your personal data matters to me. Below, I explain what data is processed when you visit this website and what rights you have.

sections.heading: 1. Controller
sections.text: The controller responsible for data processing on this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:

sections.heading: 2. Access data & server log files
sections.text: When you visit this website, the hosting provider automatically collects information that your browser transmits. This includes in particular: IP address, date and time of access, the page accessed, browser and operating system used, and the previously visited page (referrer). This data is technically necessary to display the website and ensure its stability and security. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure and functional offering). This data is not combined with other data sources or evaluated for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Hosting
sections.text: This website is hosted by an external service provider: ⟨name and address of the hosting provider, e.g. Vercel Inc.⟩. The provider processes the data generated in connection with visits to the website (see "Access data & server log files") on my behalf, based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. A data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR) is in place with the provider, ensuring compliant handling of the data.

sections.heading: 4. Contact
sections.text: The contact form on this website does not store your input on a server. When submitted, it simply opens your own email programme with the details you entered (name, email address and message), so you send the message yourself. If you contact me by email or phone, I process the information you provide in order to handle your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (initiation or performance of a contract) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to your enquiry). I delete this data as soon as it is no longer required for the purpose for which it was collected, and no statutory retention obligations apply.

sections.heading: 5. Fonts
sections.text: For a consistent display of fonts, this website uses locally hosted fonts. The font files are loaded directly from this website's server; no connection is made to third-party servers (such as Google Fonts), and no IP address is transmitted to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies & analytics
sections.text: This website does not use cookies for tracking or marketing purposes and does not use any analytics or reach-measurement services.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.text: You have the following rights regarding your personal data: access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), data portability (Art. 20 GDPR), and objection to processing (Art. 21 GDPR). To exercise these rights, an informal message to the contact details given above is sufficient.

sections.heading: 8. Right to complain to a supervisory authority
sections.text: Independent of the above, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the GDPR.

sections.heading: 9. Currency of this privacy policy
sections.text: This privacy policy is updated as needed to reflect changed legal requirements or changes to the website. The version published here is always the current one.
